verses.text: Then Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, 'My daughter, shall I not seek security for you, that it may be well with you?
verses.textZh: 路得的婆婆拿俄米對他說：女兒啊，我不當為你找個安身之處，使你享福麼？

verses.text: 'Now is not Boaz our kinsman, with whose maids you were? Behold, he winnows barley at the threshing floor tonight.
verses.textZh: 你與波阿斯的使女常在一處，波阿斯不是我們的親族麼？他今夜在場上簸大麥；

verses.text: 'Wash yourself therefore, and anoint yourself and put on your [best] clothes, and go down to the threshing floor; [but] do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
verses.textZh: 你要沐浴抹膏，換上衣服，下到場上，卻不要使那人認出你來。你等他吃喝完了，

verses.text: 'It shall be when he lies down, that you shall notice the place where he lies, and you shall go and uncover his feet and lie down; then he will tell you what you shall do.'
verses.textZh: 到他睡的時候，你看準他睡的地方，就進去掀開他腳上的被，躺臥在那裡，他必告訴你所當做的事。

verses.text: She said to her, 'All that you say I will do.'
verses.textZh: 路得說：凡你所吩咐的，我必遵行。

verses.text: So she went down to the threshing floor and did according to all that her mother-in-law had commanded her.
verses.textZh: 路得就下到場上，照他婆婆所吩咐他的而行。

verses.text: When Boaz had eaten and drunk and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain; and she came secretly, and uncovered his feet and lay down.
verses.textZh: 波阿斯吃喝完了，心裡歡暢，就去睡在麥堆旁邊。路得便悄悄地來掀開他腳上的被，躺臥在那裡。

verses.text: It happened in the middle of the night that the man was startled and bent forward; and behold, a woman was lying at his feet.
verses.textZh: 到了夜半，那人忽然驚醒，翻過身來，不料有女子躺在他的腳下。

verses.text: He said, 'Who are you?' And she answered, 'I am Ruth your maid. So spread your covering over your maid, for you are a close relative.'
verses.textZh: 他就說：你是誰？回答說：我是你的婢女路得。求你用你的衣襟遮蓋我，因為你是我一個至近的親屬。

verses.text: Then he said, 'May you be blessed of the LORD, my daughter. You have shown your last kindness to be better than the first by not going after young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.textZh: 波阿斯說：女兒啊，願你蒙耶和華賜福。你末後的恩比先前更大；因為少年人無論貧富，你都沒有跟從。

verses.text: 'Now, my daughter, do not fear. I will do for you whatever you ask, for all my people in the city know that you are a woman of excellence.
verses.textZh: 女兒啊，現在不要懼怕，凡你所說的，我必照著行；我本城的人都知道你是個賢德的女子。

verses.text: 'Now it is true I am a close relative; however, there is a relative closer than I.
verses.textZh: 我實在是你一個至近的親屬，只是還有一個人比我更近。

verses.text: 'Remain this night, and when morning comes, if he will redeem you, good; let him redeem you. But if he does not wish to redeem you, then I will redeem you, as the LORD lives. Lie down until morning.'
verses.textZh: 你今夜在這裡住宿，明早他若肯為你盡親屬的本分，就由他罷！倘若不肯，我指著永生的耶和華起誓，我必為你盡了本分，你只管躺到天亮。

verses.text: So she lay at his feet until morning and rose before one could recognize another; and he said, 'Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.'
verses.textZh: 路得便在他腳下躺到天快亮，人彼此不能辨認的時候就起來了。波阿斯說：不可使人知道有女子到場上來；

verses.text: Again he said, 'Give me the cloak that is on you and hold it.' So she held it, and he measured six [measures] of barley and laid [it] on her. Then she went into the city.
verses.textZh: 又對路得說：打開你所披的外衣。他打開了，波阿斯就撮了六簸箕大麥，幫他扛在肩上，他便進城去了。

verses.text: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, 'How did it go, my daughter?' And she told her all that the man had done for her.
verses.textZh: 路得回到婆婆那裡，婆婆說：女兒啊，怎麼樣了？路得就將那人向他所行的述說了一遍，

verses.text: She said, 'These six [measures] of barley he gave to me, for he said, 'Do not go to your mother-in-law empty-handed.''
verses.textZh: 又說：那人給了我六簸箕大麥，對我說：你不可空手回去見你的婆婆。

verses.text: Then she said, 'Wait, my daughter, until you know how the matter turns out; for the man will not rest until he has settled it today.'
verses.textZh: 婆婆說：女兒啊，你只管安坐等候，看這事怎樣成就，因為那人今日不辦成這事必不休息。
